frame.name: Twintails
frame.description: Shoots two rockets, one Void and one Solar, that can track onto the same target. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

perks.name: Confined Launch
perks.description:
This weapon's launch parameters are particularly stable.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases blast radius
  •  Decreases projectile speed

perks.name: High-Velocity Rounds
perks.description:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Play with Your Prey
perks.description: The Void rocket suppresses combatants. The Solar rocket scorches.

perks.name: Composite Stock
perks.description:
This weapon has a versatile dual-purpose stock.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

catalyst.name: Third Tail
catalyst.description: Adds another rocket to the volley that deals Arc damage and jolts combatants.
